WHY IT IS SEPARATE: the root tsconfig includes only 'src' and is built for
the browser (DOM lib, Bundler resolution, vite/client types). api/ runs on
Node as ESM, so it needs Node resolution, Node types and no DOM. Folding
them into one config would either weaken the browser config or fail on the
WHY IT EXISTS AT ALL: api/ was outside the typecheck scope entirely, so a
type error there passed `pnpm typecheck`, passed the build (Vercel compiles
functions separately) and first showed up as a 500 on a live booking.
Run via `pnpm typecheck`, which now runs both.
